history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: the site is NOT in Tonk town - Kakor Fort stands at Kakor village, Tonk district (near Uniara, PIN 304032), about 20 km from Tonk bus stand. Documented with the corrected location. IDENTITY PROVISIONAL: 'Kakor Fort and Temple' is a composite CSV label; the fort itself is well attested (partially ruined fort built by the people of Uniyara State about 700 years ago per travel vloggers; site of the 1759 Kakor War - about 17 battles between the Rajputs of Jaipur State and the Marathas ending in a peace treaty; three ancient village gateways; historic stepwell/baori; visitors deterred by honeybee colonies). Which 'Temple' the label refers to is UNVERIFIED - IGNCA ASI documentation records multiple temples at Kakor village, including Shree Kalyan Rai jee ka Mandir (RJ/TNK-085) and an 18th-century Digambar Jain Mandir (RJ/TNK-086), plus chhatris. Treat the temple component as provisional until field-verified.

town_description: Kakor is a historic village in Tonk district on the Sawai Madhopur road (Gumanpura side), roughly 20 km from Tonk town, with a partially ruined hill fort, three old gateways, stepwells and several documented temples and chhatris. It is one of the least-visited heritage sites of the district.
